# apicp_mail_domain (Resource)

Manages a mail domain (Postfix + Dovecot, SQL-backed virtual maps) via apicp. Creates a dedicated Unix user for this domain's mailbox storage — see `unix_user`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_mail_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# A domain whose outgoing mail goes through a relay of its own (apicp v0.8.0 or later; see
# apicp_mail_relay). relay_id = "" puts it back on the server's default relay.
resource "apicp_mail_domain" "shop" {
  name     = "shop.example"
  relay_id = apicp_mail_relay.shop.id
}

# New mail stored compressed (zstd at its default level 3; needs apicp v0.8.0).
# Mail already stored is compressed with `apicp mail compress-existing --domain archive.example.com`.
resource "apicp_mail_domain" "archive" {
  name        = "archive.example.com"
  compression = "zstd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Mail domain, e.g. `example.com`. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `compression` (String) How new mail of this domain is stored: `zstd` (default), `lz4`, `gz`, `bz2` or `off` (Dovecot's mail_compress plugin; mail programs notice nothing). `zstd` (level 3) is the right choice almost always: as small as gzip, about ten times faster. `lz4` uses the least CPU and saves less; `gz` for compatibility; high zstd levels only for archive mailboxes; `bz2` has no advantage. Only methods the server's Dovecot can write are accepted (`apicp_mail_settings.compression_methods`). Mail already stored is not changed: compress or decompress it with `apicp mail compress-existing` / `decompress-existing` (a one-off job, deliberately not a Terraform resource); turning compression off keeps compressed mail readable. Cannot change while such a job of the domain runs. Needs apicp v0.8.0.
- `compression_level` (Number) The method's level: `zstd` 1-22, `gz` 1-9, `bz2` 1-9 (block size); `lz4` and `off` take none. Left out, the method's own default: zstd 3, gz 6, bz2 9 (0 for lz4 and off). `0` also means that default, and apicp's level 0 and the default count as the same setting, so neither plans a change to the other.
- `disable_imap` (Boolean) Switch IMAP off for every mailbox in this domain (logins over IMAP fail; webmail uses IMAP, so it stops too). Mail is still delivered. Default `false`.
- `disable_pop3` (Boolean) Switch POP3 off for every mailbox in this domain. Mail is still delivered. Default `false`.
- `max_emails_per_hour` (Number) Outgoing mail (recipients) from this domain's mailboxes and its website over a rolling hour, on top of the account's package `max_emails_per_hour`. Mail over it is refused for now (451): a website's mail stays queued and goes out later by itself, a mail program keeps it in its Outbox to send again. `0` (default) = unlimited.
- `relay_id` (String) ID of the relay (an `apicp_mail_relay`, or the default relay's ID) this domain's outgoing mail goes through: mail whose envelope sender is in this domain. `""` = the server's default relay (bounces and every other sender always use that one). The relay must have no login and not be on port 465 (all relays share Postfix's one TLS setting), unless it is the default relay itself. Leave it out to leave the relay as it is on the server (the panel and `apicp maildomain relay` set it too) - it then shows the server's value. Only an admin account's token may set it. Needs apicp v0.8.0 or later.

### Read-Only

- `compressed_mail` (Boolean) Some of the domain's stored mail may be compressed (compression was on, or compress-existing ran, since the last whole-domain decompress-existing that left nothing compressed). apicp backups store such a domain's mail decompressed.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `unix_user` (String) Dedicated Unix user apicp created for this domain's mailbox storage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_mail_domain.example mdom_abc123
```
